function focusedGroups(){
 const spec=ROLE_FOCUS[state.role]||ROLE_FOCUS["Master"], out={};
 const isTug=vessel().type.includes("Tug");
 const special=isTug?null:(vessel().type.includes("Chemical")?"chemical-tanker-workspace":(vessel().type.includes("Tanker")?"oil-tanker-workspace":null));
 Object.entries(spec).forEach(([g,ids])=>{
   if(g==="Römorkör" && !isTug) return;
   const arr=[...ids]; if(g==="Operations"&&special&&!arr.includes(special)) arr.push(special);
   out[g]=arr.map(id=>SCREEN_MAP[id]).filter(Boolean);
 });
 out["Analiz"]=[SCREEN_MAP["__analysis__"]];
 if(SCREEN_MAP["pilot-mode"]) out["Pilot"]=[SCREEN_MAP["pilot-mode"]];
 return out;
}
function renderNav(){
  const q=navFilter.trim().toLowerCase();
  const source=q?GROUPS:(state.navMode==="full"?GROUPS:focusedGroups());
  $("#nav").innerHTML=Object.entries(source).map(([g,items])=>{
    const visible=items.filter(x=>x && (!q || (x.name+" "+x.domain+" "+x.id).toLowerCase().includes(q)));
    if(q && !visible.length) return "";
    const open=q || visible.some(x=>x.id===state.currentScreen) || g==="Command" || g==="Pilot";
    return `<div class="nav-group ${open?"open":""}" data-group="${esc(g)}">
      <button class="nav-group-head" data-action="toggle-group"><span>${groupIcon(g)}</span><span>${esc(g)}</span><span class="count">${visible.length}</span><span class="chev">›</span></button>
      <div class="nav-items">${visible.map(x=>`<button class="nav-item ${x.id===state.currentScreen?"active":""}" data-screen="${esc(x.id)}"><span class="dot"></span><span>${esc(x.name)}</span></button>`).join("")}</div>
    </div>`;
  }).join("");
  const b=$("#navModeBtn"); if(b) b.querySelector(".txt").textContent=state.navMode==="full"?"Tüm Ekranlar":"Rol Menüsü";
}
function groupIcon(g){return {"Analiz":"◈","Command":"⌁","Fleet":"≋","People":"◎","Operations":"↗","Safety":"◇","Technical":"⚙","Supply":"▣","Knowledge":"▤","Assurance":"✓","Regulatory":"§","Intelligence":"✦","Mobile":"▥","Administration":"⚙","Pilot":"▶"}[g]||"•"}
function navigate(id){
  if(!SCREEN_MAP[id]) return;

  $(".main")?.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:"smooth"});
  $("#sidebar").classList.remove("show"); $("#mobileOverlay").classList.remove("show");
}

  updateTopbar();
}

function fieldDefaultPolicy(f){
 const raw=String(f.d??"").trim();
 return ((raw==="No"&&f.u!=="checkbox")||raw==="Prototype value if valid"||(f.s==="Date/Time"&&raw==="Yes"))?"NO_IMPLICIT_DEFAULT":"SOURCE_OR_DERIVED";
}
function resolvedFieldDefault(f){
 const raw=String(f.d??"").trim(), opts=String(f.o||"").split(";").map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean);
 // POL-DEFAULT-01 approved 2026-10-27; raw source contract remains intact.
 if(fieldDefaultPolicy(f)==="NO_IMPLICIT_DEFAULT")return "";
 if(raw==="No" && /^checkbox$/i.test(f.u))return false;
 if(!raw || raw==="No" || ["System","Context role/user","Prototype value if valid","Today","Current"].includes(raw))return "";
 if(raw==="Yes" && (/Date\/Time/i.test(f.s)||!opts.includes(raw)))return "";
 if(opts.length>1 && !opts.includes(raw))return "";
 if(/numeric|number/i.test(f.s+" "+f.u) && !Number.isFinite(Number(raw)))return "";
 if(/date|time/i.test(f.s+" "+f.u) && !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/.test(raw))return "";
 return raw;
}
function fieldHtml(f,idx=0){
 const req=String(f.m||"").toLowerCase().includes("yes")||String(f.m||"").toLowerCase().includes("business");
 const opts=String(f.o||"").split(";").map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean);
 const id=`fld_${f.k}_${idx}`, defaultValue=resolvedFieldDefault(f);
 let input;
 if(/^checkbox$/i.test(f.u)) input=`<input id="${id}" type="checkbox" ${defaultValue===true?"checked":""}>`;
 else if(opts.length>1) input=`<select id="${id}"><option value="">Seçiniz</option>${opts.map(o=>`<option value="${esc(o)}" ${o===defaultValue?"selected":""}>${esc(o)}</option>`).join("")}</select>`;
 else if(/date|time/i.test(f.s+" "+f.u+" "+f.l)) input=`<input id="${id}" type="date" value="${esc(defaultValue)}">`;
 else if(/numeric|number/i.test(f.s+" "+f.u)) input=`<input id="${id}" type="number" value="${esc(defaultValue)}">`;
 else if(/narrative|textarea|description|notes|reason/i.test(f.s+" "+f.u+" "+f.l)) input=`<textarea id="${id}" placeholder="${esc(f.l)}"></textarea>`;
 else input=`<input id="${id}" value="${esc(defaultValue)}" placeholder="${esc(f.l)}">`;
 input=input.replace(/<(input|select|textarea) /, `<$1 name="${esc(f.k)}" ${req?"required":""} `);
 return `<div class="field ${/description|notes|reason|source trace/i.test(f.l)?"span-2":""}"><label for="${id}">${esc(f.l)} ${req?'<span

}

Römorkaj planı limiti ve Kaptan onayı gerekli.','Current > 2.1 kn forecast around 10:50. Towage plan limit and Master acknowledgement required.')}</div></div>`;};
 renderTowageExecution=function(s){return `${pageHead(s,L('Römorkaj işinin onboard yürütme, zaman, towline, haberleşme, olay ve kanıt kaydı.','Onboard execution, time, towline, communications, event and evidence record for towage job.'),`<button class="btn" data-screen="towage-risk-briefing">${L('Brifing','Briefing')}</button><button class="btn primary" data-action="towage-demo-gate">${L('Operasyonu Başlat','Start Operation')}</button>`)}
   <div class="grid kpis">${kpi(L('İş','Job'),'TJ-2602','MT AURORA Escort')}${kpi(L('Durum','State'),'READY',L('Kaptan başlangıç onayı bekleniyor','Master start pending'))}${kpi('Towline','READY',L('SWL doğrulandı','SWL verified'))}${kpi(L('Haberleşme','Comms'),'GOOD',L('VHF kanalı doğrulandı','VHF channel confirmed'))}</div>
   <div class="grid layout-2"><div class="card pad"><div class="card-title">${L('Operasyon zaman çizelgesi','Execution timeline')}</div><div class="list">${[['10:02',L('Brifing tamamlandı','Briefing complete'),'VERIFIED'],['10:05',L('Acil bırakma testi','Emergency release test'),'PASS'],['10:10',L('Towline hazır','Towline ready'),'READY'],['10:15',L('Başlangıç','Start'),'PENDING']].map(x=>`<div class="list-item"><div class="list-icon">•</div><div class="list-body"><strong>${x[0]} · ${x[1]}</strong></div><div>${badge(x[2])}</div></div>`).join('')}</div></div>
   <div class="card pad"><div class="card-title">${L('Kaptan yetkisi','Master authority')}</div><div class="callout danger">${L('AI veya shore dispatcher operasyonu başlatamaz, devam ettiremez veya iptal kararını veremez. Kaptan/Tug Master nihai onboard yetkidir.','AI or shore dispatcher cannot start, continue or abort the operation. Master/Tug Master is the final onboard authority.')}</div><div style="display:flex;gap:7px;margin-top:12px"><button class="btn" data-action="suspend-towage">${L('Durdur','Suspend')}</button><button class="btn danger" data-action="abort-towage">${L('İptal Et','Abort')}</button><button class="btn primary" data-action="complete-towage">${L('Tamamla + Kanıt','Complete + Evidence')}</button></div></div></div>`;};
 tugJobTable=function(list){return table([L('İş','Job'),L('Gemi / Tip','Vessel / Type'),L('Plan','Plan'),L('Römorkörler','Tugs'),'BP',L('Hazırlık','Readiness'),L('Çakışma','Conflict'),''],list.map(j=>`<tr><td><strong>${j.id}</strong></td><td>${j.vessel}<br><small>${j.type}</small></td><td>${j.start}-${j.end}</td><td>${j.tugs}</td><td>${j.requiredBP}</td><td>${badge(j.state)}</td><td>${badge(j.conflict)}</td><td><button class="btn small ghost" data-screen="tug-job-detail">${L('Aç','Open')}</button></td></tr>`));};
})();

 function targetLang(){return (state.lang||'tr').toLowerCase()==='en'?'en':'tr';}
 function translateText(text,lang=targetLang()){
   if(!text||!text.trim()) return text;
   for(const [en,tr] of UI_CONTROL_PAIRS){if(text.trim()===(lang==='tr'?en:tr))return text.replace(text.trim(),lang==='tr'?tr:en);}

   let enScore=0,trScore=0;

     if(en && en.length>=3 && text.includes(en)) enScore+=Math.min(en.length,40);
     if(tr && tr.length>=3 && text.includes(tr)) trScore+=Math.min(tr.length,40);
   }
   if(lang==='en' && enScore>=trScore && !/[çğıöşüÇĞİÖŞÜ]/.test(text)) return text;
   if(lang==='tr' && trScore>enScore) return text;

   for(const [en,tr] of list){
